description: This file implements an in-memory operation management system for asynchronous task handling, including defining operation structures, error types, and the OperationManager interface with a Map-based implementation.

classes.name: OperationResult
classes.description: Struct holding the result of an operation, including error and value.

classes.name: OperationManager
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing asynchronous operations.

classes.name: mapOMOperationEntry
classes.description: Struct representing an individual operation entry with synchronization primitives.

classes.name: MapOM
classes.description: Map-based implementation of OperationManager, managing operations in-memory with synchronization.

methods.name: NewMapOM
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new MapOM instance.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new operation with a unique ID and adds it to the map.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an operation by its name.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Provides the result of a completed operation.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Marks an operation as complete and sets the result.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for an operation to complete up to a specified timeout.
